remarks: Walk to town or train from this elegant and fresh brownstone-style townhome in Darien. Enjoy three levels of living space with a clean, contemporary flair. Main floor features a sleek eat-in kitchen renovated in 2020 with hardwood floors, marble backsplash and new countertops. Also on the main level is a spacious and bright living/dining area with a fireplace, custom bookshelves, handsome moldings, upgraded lighting as well as a chic powder room. Additional living space is available outside on a private terrace off the living room. Upper level has two spacious bedrooms bathed in light with architectural windows and cathedral ceilings. Both bedrooms have en suite bathrooms updated with classic fixtures and finishes. Lower level includes laundry and additional finished space with a custom office niche and a wet bar that is suitable for work-from-home, play room or additional guest quarters. You'll love the convenience and sophistication that Pine Brook offers in the heart of Darien. This 20-unit complex is professionally managed and well-maintained with reasonable common charges. Recent capital improvements include roof replacement less than four years ago and driveway repaving in the past year. There are no outstanding assessments for these projects. Agent related to owner. Rentals: Complex allows 4 leased units at one time; currently no open slots for new rentals. Surveillance: Ring door bell/camera does not work; nanny cam in crib area may be ON.
